scope: Prospective sequence-model feasibility comparison; no runtime promotion or parity claim
confirmation: Six sealed confirmation clips remain absent; old and new development results retain exposure history. No holdout is used for this training-only feasibility stage.

representation.rotation: 6D first two world-rotation matrix columns in normalized observed pelvis frame
representation.observation_masks: Separate position/orientation masks per joint/frame; hidden values erased before conditioning
representation.time: Explicit timestamps, interval duration and normalized time
representation.known_values: Exact clamp before loss/output and each denoising step; physical rig validation still required
representation.contacts_and_style: Existing explicit contact projection retained; learned contact/style conditioning remains a separate unmet requirement, not inferred from unlabelled data

shared_backbone.type: Noncausal residual temporal convolution, full sequence output

direct.objective: Full-sequence residual regression against observed-only linear baseline

diffusion.objective: Conditional clean-residual denoising with observed entries clamped
diffusion.replication_claim: Original project implementation of a general conditional diffusion design, not a reproduction of CondMDI

stage_a.purpose: Implementation, information-boundary and learning-capacity checks before corpus training
stage_a.hidden_label_access: Training labels only, separate from request features
stage_a.determinism: CPU eval parity of exported NumPy weights; seeded CUDA forward/backward; exact known channels

stage_b.purpose: Fit and compare on existing train partition, then run unchanged development gates and broader authored constraints
stage_b.status: NOT AUTHORIZED TO START BY THIS PLAN until stage-A implementation and frozen dataset/window/augmentation manifest are verified
stage_b.selection: Fixed final epochs, or training-only stop for nonfinite/budget. No repeated validation tuning. If both fail, report model/data gap.

runtime_and_resource_budgets.deployment_candidate: Export inert NPZ arrays to matching NumPy inference; no PyTorch dependency in addon

data_policy.existing_CMU: Pinned Hahne conversion and prior publisher-use evidence retained; no raw motion in addon
data_policy.LAFAN1: Not selected: publisher labels dataset CC BY-NC-ND4.0
data_policy.CondMDI: Code MIT but weights and dataset terms separate; no pretrained weights or dependent assets imported
